name: OpenPhone (Secondly)
notes: Developer preview based on LineageOS 23.2 / Android 16, targeting the Pixel 9a first, with an emulator build path. The repository holds an overlay (the privileged OpenPhoneAssistant app and vendor configuration), patch stacks for LineageOS repositories and build scripts. The frameworks_base patches add an agent manager service with task-scoped input action execution, a framework-mediated UI tree snapshot, opt-in screenshots captured by system_server, a pending-action confirmation flow and a tamper-evident audit log. overlay/vendor/openphone/config/openphone_model_tools.json lists 54 model-visible tools, including screen reading, tap, swipe, typing, app launch, messages, calendar, watchers and background jobs. Models are reached through a development model broker in services/. It is unrelated to the HKUDS OpenPhone mobile foundation-model paper (arXiv 2510.22009).
summary: AI-native Android OS on LineageOS whose privileged assistant uses new framework services to read the screen and UI tree and tap, swipe and type across apps, with confirmations, watchers and an audit log.
